content:
Tian: hey all — i'm Tian, joined infra this week. quick onboarding snag: the onboarding doc references an 'SLO Overview' Grafana dashboard but i can't see it in Dashboards -> Manage. also my panels show 'Paused' and i don't see the refresh dropdown. did i miss a permission step?
Leah: welcome Tian! the SLO dashboard lives in the 'infra' org space. did you sign in via SSO? if you used a personal login it won't map to the org. try https://grafana.redwood.com/explore then left nav -> Dashboards -> Manage -> search 'SLO'.
Jason: if panels are paused that's usually template-variable related or the dashboard has a default timepicker set to 'Paused' (rare). can you paste the url you have for the dashboard or a screenshot of the top-right timepicker?
Tian: here's the url i'm opening: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/abcd1234/slo-overview
Tian: and the top-right shows "Paused" where the refresh interval usually is — clicking the clock icon doesn't open anything for me.
Leah: sounds like a viewer-level UI quirk if your session hasn't fully got org permissions. devex-bot will link the access flow below.
devex-bot: For Grafana access requests please file a ticket at https://tickets.redwood.com/issue/GRAFANA-ACCESS with your SSO email, team, and reason. Requests auto-assign to eng-infra and typical turnaround is 1 business day.
oncall-sre: i can grant a temporary Viewer access to the infra org if you ping me your SSO email here or DM. note: default SLO dashboard refresh is 5m to protect backend queries.
Tian: thanks — i filed GRAFANA-ACCESS-2345 (linked in the ticket) and DM'd @oncall-sre my SSO. i see the dashboard now after the access change, awesome. one follow-up: how do i switch refresh to 30s for live debug? i tried Edit -> Time range -> Refresh but edit is blocked for me (permission denied).
Leah: short answer: you don't need Editor to change your local refresh. top-right timepicker has a per-user dropdown (clock icon) where you can pick 30s for your session. editing the dashboard to change the default requires Editor role.
Jason: FYI switching to 30s will spike queries for some panels (especially those with heavy aggregations). prefer enabling 30s only on a cloned panel or in a non-prod org. if you need Editor temporarily, mention the exact window + justification in the access ticket.
Tian: got it — used the per-user clock dropdown, working now. i won't keep it at 30s for long. thanks everyone for the quick help! marking this resolved for me.
Leah: welcome again — if you want a quick walk-through of the SLO dashboard let me know and i can show which panels are safe to poll faster. :wave:
